changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Version %1
changelog.section.resources.title: Resource center
changelog.section.resources.item1: Search shaders, resource packs and data packs from both Modrinth and CurseForge.
changelog.section.resources.item2: Filter by game version and mod loader, and check project details, screenshots, downloads and last update.
changelog.section.resources.item3: Download straight from the results and install into the instance's shaderpacks / resourcepacks / datapacks folder automatically.
changelog.section.download.title: Download experience
changelog.section.download.item1: New confirmation dialog: pick the target instance and version before downloading, and cancel at any time.
changelog.section.download.item2: The unified download panel shows live progress and speed, collapses when finished, and can be dismissed with ✕.
changelog.section.download.item3: Cancelling a download stops the transfer immediately and cleans up unfinished temporary files.
changelog.section.crash.title: Crash diagnosis
changelog.section.crash.item1: When the game exits abnormally, Beacon now reads the crash report, JVM error log and game output automatically.
changelog.section.crash.item2: It recognises common causes such as out-of-memory, wrong Java version, mod conflicts and graphics driver problems.
changelog.section.crash.item3: The crash dialog lets you copy the diagnosis, reveal the report file and open the full log.
changelog.section.ui.title: Interface & kernel
changelog.section.ui.item1: Updated launcher kernel with the new search and download capabilities.
changelog.section.ui.item2: Smoother page transitions and list scrolling.
changelog.section.ui.item3: Fixed download card buttons, dialog layouts and other interface issues.

crash.title: Game crashed
crash.cat.outOfMemory.title: Out of memory
crash.cat.outOfMemory.detail: The game ran out of memory while loading. Increase the allocated memory in the launch settings and make sure other high-memory programs are closed, then try again.
crash.cat.javaVersion.title: Java version mismatch
crash.cat.javaVersion.detail: This instance needs a different Java runtime than the one currently used. Install the required Java in the Java manager, or pick another Java in the instance settings.
crash.cat.mainClass.title: Incomplete or corrupted version
crash.cat.mainClass.detail: The game's main class or libraries could not be found. The files for this version are probably damaged or incomplete — re-download this version and try again.
crash.cat.graphics.title: Graphics / driver problem
crash.cat.graphics.detail: The game could not initialise the graphics window. This is usually caused by an outdated or broken graphics driver. Update your GPU driver and try again.
crash.cat.native.title: JVM native crash
crash.cat.native.detail: The Java virtual machine crashed at the native level, which is often caused by a broken mod, an incompatible Java runtime or a graphics driver issue. A detailed hs_err log was written next to the game log.
crash.cat.modIssue.title: Mod conflict or missing dependency
crash.cat.modIssue.detail: A mod failed to load, is incompatible with this game version, or is missing a required dependency. Remove recently added mods or check for missing dependencies, then try again.
crash.cat.network.title: Network error
crash.cat.network.detail: The game hit a network error. Check your connection or proxy settings; this can affect resource packs, skins and online authentication.
crash.cat.unknown.title: Unknown cause
crash.cat.unknown.detail: The launcher could not identify a known cause for this crash. Open the full log or the crash report below for the raw details.
crash.cat.launchFailed.title: Game failed to launch
crash.cat.launchFailed.detail: The launcher could not create the game process — the Java path is invalid, the required Java runtime is missing, or security software blocked it. Check the Java path in the settings, or reinstall the runtime from the Java manager.
